mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls indicates a tightening labor market that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity, as measured by housing starts above 1500 thousand units, the demand for consumer goods and services accelerates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 1400.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, when the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, the cost of capital rises and equity valuations contract, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances.
